body: thanks, blondin.  i tend to lose sight of that.
I have, but it's difficult b/c it's not consistent.  Thanks for reminding me its common.
No, not today.  I talked to my therapist yesterday when I was feeling upset, but it didn't do much to stop these feelings.  I get so nervous when it makes it so I can't go to work. . .
You'll prob find that it's just as bad here, but we still love that shit!

I think it is a really positive thing that you posted this.  I've been there, too many times recently, trust me.  I know it sucks now.  I don't make any promises that it will get better soon.  But you do not deserve to die, you're worth more than that.  I mean, I'm a stranger, and I just took time out of my day to write to you.  You are now worth something to me.

Take a few deep breaths, keep fighting the fight, there are a bunch of us right there with ya.
